description: Legal entity identifier (LEI) records from GLEIF's public database: search by legal name (up to 5 matches) or look up one 20-character LEI. Returns legal name, country, city, entity and registration status. Parent companies are not expanded here (a second request per entity would be needed). Choose this tool for: Legal entity identifier records from GLEIF's public. Close alternatives on this server: agent_intel_api_sla_liveness_benchmark (Liveness and latency of one public HTTPS endpoint, measured); agent_intel_citation_verifier (Checks up to 5 references against public registries: DOI). Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
